reviews.title: Perfect for at home, and frequent travelers.
reviews.comment: I recently bought the SanDisk 2TB Extreme PRO Portable SSD, and it’s been a total workhorse for my on-the-go storage needs! The read and write speeds—up to 2000MB/s—are blazing fast, making it a breeze to transfer huge video files or back up my photo library in no time. Its compact, rugged design with an aluminum chassis and IP65 water/dust resistance feels super durable, perfect for tossing in my bag without worrying about drops or spills. The included USB-C and USB-A cables make it versatile for my laptop and older devices, though I’ve read some Macs only hit 1050MB/s due to port limitations, which hasn’t been an issue for me. My only gripe is it can get warm during heavy use, but the sleep mode cools it down fast. For about $200 on sale, it’s a fantastic deal for creators needing reliable, high-speed storage—highly recommend, just double-check your device’s USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 support
